verses.text: Moise assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and i-a zis lui them, These are the words which the DOMNUL has commanded, that you should do them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the DOMNUL: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise a vorbit lui all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the DOMNUL commanded, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
‘Take from among you an offering to the DOMNUL. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the DOMNUL’s offering: să pleceld, silver, bronze,
blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, să pleceats’ hair,
rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the DOMNUL has commanded: (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the DOMNUL’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of să pleceld; even every man who offered an offering of să pleceld to the DOMNUL.
Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, să pleceats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the DOMNUL’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their mânăs, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the să pleceats’ hair.
The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the DOMNUL; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the DOMNUL had commanded to be made by Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui the children of Israel, Behold, the DOMNUL has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He has filled him with the Spirit of Dumnezeu, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and to make skillful works, to work in să pleceld, in silver, in bronze,
in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
